# RadioGroup

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:radio-group` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A native fieldset of radios, each drawn as a Kerf circle beside its label, with the group label above, per-choice hints, and hint and error text below, stacked or wrapping.

## When to use

Choose exactly one of a few options that should stay visible with room for a label and hint each, with native keyboard behavior and form participation.

- A form asks for one of two to about six options that people should compare at a glance, each with a readable label and an optional hint.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for many options or a compact toolbar value; use Select.
- Do not use to switch a view; use SegmentedControl.
- Do not use for chip-styled or color choices; use ChoiceChips.

**Alternatives:**

- [Radio Group](./wa-radio-group.md) (prefer-over)
- [Radio](./wa-radio.md) (prefer-over)
- [Select](./select.md) (nearest) — Use Select for a long list.
- [ChoiceChips](./choice-chips.md) (nearest) — Use ChoiceChips for wrapping pill choices.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/radio-group` — exports `RadioGroup`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/radio-group` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/radio-group.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/radio-group`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiradio-group) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

- vertical or horizontal

- whole group disabled
- hint
- error
- required
- default or compact size

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** value; choices and their copy; validation and error copy.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The label and hint sit on the text column (1px + 8px); each choice's 20px circle (18px compact) sits on the group's inline-start edge, where a Checkbox draws its box, 8px (7px) before its label; choices stack 12px apart, and a choice hint aligns with its label text.

## Accessibility

- A native \<fieldset role="radiogroup"> named by its legend (label) or ariaLabel; each choice is a native radio inside its \<label>, invisibly over the drawn circle. The browser owns the interaction: one Tab stop, arrow keys move and select, and the checked radio submits its value under name.
- The group's hint and error form its aria-description; an error sets aria-invalid on the group and the danger border on each circle. required sets each radio's native required and aria-required on the group. A choice's hint is that radio's aria-description.
